title: Counts vs. Relative Frequencies
note: Knowing when percentages are mandatory instead of raw counts.

title: Calculating Quartiles with Even/Odd Sample Sizes

title: Mastering the Z-Score Calculation Direction

Is it mathematically safe to think of the equation as subtraction rather than addition to make the calculation faster, or should I always strictly use the standard formula x = μ + zσ? Walk me through the algebraic logic.
